item.text:
Added view transitions to the gallery. The thumbnail and detail hero now share a transition name so the product image morphs between pages. Product links use forward and back transition types for directional slides, and Suspense skeletons animate into content. The CSS disables these animations and the existing skeleton pulse when the user prefers reduced motion.

React and React DOM were updated to 19.3.1 because the installed 19.1 release did not export `ViewTransition`.

The production build, TypeScript check, and HTTP checks for both routes passed. I could not visually verify the animations because this workspace has no browser executable. Next.js also does not animate browser Back and Forward history navigation; the directional return transition runs through the “Back to products” link.
